source.original_text: Let n>=3, kappa>=4, and let O have the actual full orthogonal Haar probability law. Write U=O_11 and A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T). For every Borel h with E|h(U)| finite, E[det(O)sqrt(det A_O)h(U)] equals ((-1)^(n-1)(sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1)/2^n) E[((sqrt(kappa)+1)U-(sqrt(kappa)-1))h(U)].

decoder_context: Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ is the full real orthogonal group, with inherited finite matrix topology and its Borel sigma-algebra; both determinant signs are allowed. It is compact, nonempty and second countable, with those facts constructed internally.

The displayed Measure.haarMeasure constructor is the actual Haar law normalized on top, the entire compact group. IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. No arbitrary caller-supplied law or conditional distribution is substituted.

A finite index set S is also its finite subtype of indices. Matrix.submatrix along the two subtype inclusions is the principal submatrix; the empty determinant is one. Fin n indices start at zero. The explicit proof inside the first index constructs its membership from the dimension inequality.

Integrable is actual absolute Bochner L1 integrability under the displayed Borel measure; Measurable h is Borel measurability on the real line. The given L1 condition is on the composition with the displayed entry, not an assertion that h is globally bounded.

All matrices and scalars are real. Matrix multiplication, transpose and determinant have their usual finite-dimensional meanings. Scalar multiplication is entrywise, 1 is identity, and Real.sqrt is the nonnegative real square root. The anonymous statement fully expands the displayed precision formula.

source_review.evidence:
Independent evidence boundary: I read only the two anti-anchored reviewer packets, the pinned raw HTML (verified SHA256 6bc5ddc1e19cea9ba1dfe862fa79bc69fe861dff045d6ad1c7baa4a113c37915), and actual local dependency definitions. I did not read prior reviews, verdicts, canonical audits or coordinator notes. I audited the complete current_lean_module contained in both packets, rather than treating compiled=true as mathematical or source-fidelity evidence.

Raw source: A2.SS2.p2 explicitly fixes n>=3, kappa>=4, full O(n), U=O_11. Lemma B.6 says every Borel h with E|h(U)|<infinity. A2.E15 is the claimed signed expectation identity. A2.E16-18 establish the precise precision determinant and positive square-root branch; A2.Ex53 and Ex54 use D_i row reflection, preserve U and reverse the selected principal determinant. A2.SS2.SSS1.p3.3 explicitly states finite expectations from |det O_(S,S)|<=1; Ex55 keeps precisely the empty and first-singleton terms and the displayed parity coefficient.

Actual dependencies: Matrix.orthogonalGroup is the full unitaryGroup over the real trivial-star ring, with membership A*A^T=I (equivalently A^T*A=I), with no det=1 predicate. OrthogonalHaar.lean explicitly sets the Borel measurable space, inherits the finite matrix topology and second countability, and proves compactness as a closed subset of the entrywise [-1,1] cube using entry_norm_bound_of_unitary. orthogonalHaar is exactly Measure.haarMeasure top. Mathlib Haar/Basic.lean defines normalization on PositiveCompacts K0 and proves haarMeasure_self=1 and left invariance; taking top gives mass one on the whole group. The local spec proves probability plus Haar uniqueness, and map_mul_left is the genuine pushforward identity for every group element, including determinant-negative reflections. There is no abstract assumed measure, SO restriction or conditioned replacement.

Whole-module helper scope: (1) rowReflection constructs the literal diagonal with one -1 and otherwise +1, and proves its square/transpose product is I. (2) reflection_mul_apply computes actual left multiplication entrywise, so it flips one row. (3) reflection_minor_det factors the restricted diagonal on S, uses det_mul/det_diagonal and exactly one negative factor using hiS; it does not require hi0. (4) integrable_minor_weight has arbitrary n,S and arbitrary Integrable real g, proves continuity of the determinant of the actual principal submatrix, gets a finite uniform bound from compactness, and applies the actual Integrable.bdd_mul. Its constant can depend on n,S, but imposes no new public hypothesis or bound on h. (5) principalMinor_weighted_integral_eq_zero first returns that L1 result, then uses hi0 to fix U under reflection, the actual Haar pushforward, MeasurableEquiv.mulLeft measurable embedding, integral_map and integral_neg, giving I=-I and I=0. (6) det_affine_principalMinor is a deterministic identity for all real matrices M, all real a,b and every n. Alternating row multilinearity enumerates all finite subsets S, extraction of row scalars gives a^|S| b^(n-|S|), and Mathlib det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det identifies precisely the principal determinant with no extra permutation sign. I checked that Mathlib theorem's actual block-triangular proof. (7) affine_det_weighted_average retains Borel/L1 assumptions and arbitrary real a,b; every finite-sum term is integrable by helper (4), so integral_finsetSum is used with genuine hypotheses. Any S other than empty or {j0} contains an i!=j0 and vanishes by public cancellation. Empty determinant is 1 and singleton determinant is U, yielding b^n E[g]+a b^(n-1)E[Ug]. No convergence or infinite-sum interchange is hidden. (8) signed_sqrt_det_integral invokes the actual pointwise normalizer at the same n,kappa,O, substitutes a=sqrt(kappa)+1 and b=sqrt(kappa)-1 into the average with parameter -b, proves Ug integrable by |U|<=1, uses integral_sub with real L1 premises, and factors (-b)^n=(-b)^(n-1)(-b) and (-b)^(n-1)=(-1)^(n-1)b^(n-1). It retains both survivor terms and 2^(-n).

Normalizer dependency independently inspected: singleBlockPrecision is literally ((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T). singleBlockPrecision_factorization expands using O^T O=I and sqrt(kappa)^2=kappa. shiftedOrthogonal_det_pos proves every aI-tO on [0,b] nonsingular by a nonzero-kernel squared-dot-product contradiction using 0<=t<=b<a, then uses continuity and positive value a^n at zero. singleBlockPrecision_sqrt_det therefore chooses the positive branch, not an unproved sign. The signed version multiplies by O^T and transposes the determinant, matching both E18 equalities. The source's quantitative path norm lower bound is not asserted by the cancellation module or its lesson as a proved Lean bound.

Finite-expectation audit: Mathlib Integrable is AEStronglyMeasurable plus HasFiniteIntegral; for real functions this supplies the finite absolute expectation required by source Borel h and its continuous-coordinate composition. Mathlib integral_undef really does return zero for nonintegrable functions, so bare zero identities would be insufficient. Here minor integrability is a public conjunct, all affine determinant terms are individually L1 before finite-sum linearity, and the signed normalizer is pointwise a scalar times that finite polynomial. Thus its left integrand is also L1 under the stated assumptions even though the final public theorem only states the equality. The right affine-coordinate weight is L1 by the explicit Ug proof and linear combination. No use of the default integral supplies the asserted finite expectations.

Exposition audit: I checked every formula and every English mathematical step in both packet lessons against the actual module and raw source. The minor lesson accurately distinguishes its finite compactness bound C_(n,S) from the source's sharp bound one, describes the genuine reflection and Haar invariance, and labels finite L1 cancellation correctly. The signed-normalizer lesson correctly gives E18, the generic plus-b deterministic expansion, subsequent substitution of -b, the finite integral expansion, empty/singleton evaluation and parity-normalization factor. The generic expansion's b is a temporary arbitrary coefficient; the following formula explicitly uses -b for the previously defined positive b. There is no mathematical sign inconsistency. The lesson's claims about particular build/test executions were not used as evidence of mathematical equivalence; test files are outside this independent evidence boundary. No blocking source, proof or explanatory-formula defect was found.

import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.Normalizer
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.OrthogonalHaar
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Charpoly.Coeff
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L1Space.Integrable
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.Integral
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Bounded
import Mathlib.Tactic.FunProp

/-!
# Haar principal-minor cancellation for the actual precision family

Zhou--Suzuki arXiv:2610.20492v1, Appendix B.2.1, Lemma B.6.
The statement seal retains the actual Borel/L1 hypothesis and the existing
normalized full orthogonal Haar law. Private reflection and compactness adapters
produce proof ingredients internally. This is not a Gaussian density, a
conditional sign posterior, an oracle transcript theorem or a main lower bound.
-/

open Matrix MeasureTheory Set TopologicalSpace
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.OrthogonalHaar
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantFamily

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.DeterminantCancellation

private noncomputable def rowReflection {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ :=
  ⟨Matrix.diagonal (fun j => if j = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1), by
    apply (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin n) ℝ).2
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    have h : (fun j : Fin n => (if j = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) *
        (if j = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1)) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj]
    rw [h, Matrix.diagonal_one]⟩

private lemma reflection_mul_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n)
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (j k : Fin n) :
    (rowReflection i * O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ).val j k =
      (if j = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) * (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j k := by
  change ((Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin n => if j = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1)) *
    (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) j k = _
  simp only [Matrix.diagonal_mul]

private lemma reflection_minor_det {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n)
    (hiS : i ∈ S) (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (((rowReflection i * O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
      Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)
        (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det =
      -((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix
        (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det := by
  classical
  have hm : (((rowReflection i * O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
      Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)
        (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun j : S => if (j : Fin n) = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) *
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix
          (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) := by
    ext j k
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, reflection_mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  rw [hm, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  have hp : (∏ j : S, if (j : Fin n) = i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) = -1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∏ j : S, if j = (⟨i, hiS⟩ : S) then (-1 : ℝ) else 1 := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        simp only [Subtype.ext_iff]
      _ = -1 := by simp
  rw [hp, neg_one_mul]

private lemma integrable_minor_weight {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (g : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g (orthogonalHaar n)) :
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix
        (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det * g O)
      (orthogonalHaar n) := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix
        (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det) :=
    (continuous_subtype_val.matrix_submatrix _ _).matrix_det
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_univ.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
  exact hg.bdd_mul hc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun O => hC O (mem_univ O))

theorem principalMinor_weighted_integral_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (hiS : i ∈ S) (hi0 : i ≠ (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n))
    (h : ℝ → ℝ) (hh : Measurable h)
    (hL1 : Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ => h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n))) (orthogonalHaar n)) :
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ => ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det * h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n))) (orthogonalHaar n) ∧
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det * h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)) ∂orthogonalHaar n) = 0 := by
  classical
  refine ⟨integrable_minor_weight S _ hL1, ?_⟩
  let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
  have hji : j0 ≠ i := Ne.symm hi0
  let F : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun O =>
    ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix
      (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det *
        h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0)
  change (∫ O, F O ∂orthogonalHaar n) = 0
  have hodd : ∀ O, F (rowReflection i * O) = -F O := by
    intro O
    dsimp only [F]
    rw [reflection_minor_det S i hiS O]
    have hu : (rowReflection i * O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ).val j0 j0 =
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0 := by
      simpa only [if_neg hji, one_mul] using reflection_mul_apply i O j0 j0
    rw [hu]
    ring
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding
      (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ => rowReflection i * O) :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.mulLeft (rowReflection i)).measurableEmbedding
  have heq : (∫ O, F (rowReflection i * O) ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      ∫ O, F O ∂orthogonalHaar n := by
    rw [← hemb.integral_map, orthogonalHaar_map_mul_left]
  have hz : -(∫ O, F O ∂orthogonalHaar n) = ∫ O, F O ∂orthogonalHaar n := by
    simpa only [hodd, integral_neg] using heq
  linarith


private lemma det_affine_principalMinor {n : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    (a • M + b • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det =
      ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), a ^ S.card * b ^ (n - S.card) *
        (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det := by
  classical
  let D := (detRowAlternating : (Fin n → ℝ) [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
  change D ((fun i => a • M i) +
    (fun i => b • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i)) = _
  rw [D.map_add_univ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S hS
  have hs : S.piecewise (fun i => a • M i)
      (fun i => b • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i) =
      fun i => (if i ∈ S then a else b) •
        S.piecewise M (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i := by
    funext i j
    simp only [Finset.piecewise, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [hs, D.map_smul_univ]
  have hp : (∏ i : Fin n, if i ∈ S then a else b) =
      a ^ S.card * b ^ (n - S.card) := by
    have h₁ : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n => i ∈ S) = S := by
      ext i
      simp
    have h₂ : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n => i ∉ S) = Finset.univ \ S := by
      ext i
      simp
    rw [Finset.prod_ite, h₁, h₂]
    simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ S),
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [hp, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  exact Matrix.det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det M S

private lemma affine_det_weighted_average {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (a b : ℝ)
    (h : ℝ → ℝ) (hh : Measurable h)
    (hL1 : Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
        (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)
        (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n))) (orthogonalHaar n)) :
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (a • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + b • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det *
        h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
          (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)
          (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)) ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      b ^ n * (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
          (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)
          (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)) ∂orthogonalHaar n) +
      a * b ^ (n - 1) * (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
          (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)
          (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n) *
        h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
          (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)
          (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)) ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
  classical
  let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
  let g : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun O =>
    h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0)
  let m (S : Finset (Fin n)) (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :=
    ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix
      (Subtype.val : S → Fin n) (Subtype.val : S → Fin n)).det
  let c (S : Finset (Fin n)) := a ^ S.card * b ^ (n - S.card)
  have hm : ∀ S, Integrable (fun O => m S O * g O) (orthogonalHaar n) :=
    fun S => integrable_minor_weight S g hL1
  have hexp : ∀ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (a • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + b • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det *
        g O = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), c S * (m S O * g O) := by
    intro O
    rw [det_affine_principalMinor, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro S hS
    dsimp only [c, m]
    ring
  have hsum : (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (a • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + b • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det *
        g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), c S * (∫ O, m S O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
    simp_rw [hexp]
    rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun S hS => (hm S).const_mul (c S))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro S hS
    exact integral_const_mul _ _
  let K : Finset (Finset (Fin n)) := {∅, {j0}}
  have hzero : ∀ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), S ∉ K →
      c S * (∫ O, m S O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) = 0 := by
    intro S hS hSK
    have hS0 : S ≠ ∅ := by
      intro he
      apply hSK
      simp [K, he]
    have hS1 : S ≠ {j0} := by
      intro he
      apply hSK
      simp [K, he]
    have hex : ∃ i ∈ S, i ≠ j0 := by
      by_contra hnone
      push Not at hnone
      have hsub : S ⊆ {j0} := Finset.subset_singleton_iff'.2 hnone
      exact (Finset.subset_singleton_iff.mp hsub).elim hS0 hS1
    obtain ⟨i, hiS, hi0⟩ := hex
    have hz := (principalMinor_weighted_integral_eq_zero hn S i hiS hi0 h hh hL1).2
    change (∫ O, m S O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) = 0 at hz
    rw [hz, mul_zero]
  have hred : (∑ S : Finset (Fin n), c S *
      (∫ O, m S O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n)) =
      c ∅ * (∫ O, m ∅ O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) +
        c {j0} * (∫ O, m {j0} O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ S ∈ K, c S * (∫ O, m S O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) :=
        (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ K) hzero).symm
      _ = _ := by simp [K]
  have hEmpty : ∀ O, m ∅ O = 1 := by
    intro O
    exact Matrix.det_eq_one_of_card_eq_zero (by simp)
  have hOne : ∀ O, m {j0} O = (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0 := by
    intro O
    exact Matrix.det_eq_elem_of_card_eq_one (by simp) (⟨j0, by simp⟩ : ({j0} : Finset (Fin n)))
  change (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (a • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + b • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det *
        g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) = _
  rw [hsum, hred]
  simp only [hEmpty, hOne, c, Finset.card_empty, Finset.card_singleton,
    pow_zero, pow_one, Nat.sub_zero, one_mul]
  rfl

theorem signed_sqrt_det_integral {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ)
    (h : ℝ → ℝ) (hh : Measurable h)
    (hL1 : Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ => h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n))) (orthogonalHaar n)) :
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det *
        h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)) ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (Real.sqrt κ - 1) ^ (n - 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)) - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) *
            h ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n) (⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩ : Fin n)) ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
  classical
  let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
  let U (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : ℝ :=
    (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
  let g : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ := fun O => h (U O)
  let a := Real.sqrt κ + 1
  let b := Real.sqrt κ - 1
  change (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det *
        g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
    ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * b ^ (n - 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) *
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, (a * U O - b) * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n)
  have hnorm : ∀ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det =
        (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) *
          (a • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (-b) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det := by
    intro O
    simpa only [a, b, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg] using singleBlockPrecision_signed_sqrt_det hn hκ O
  have hstep : (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det *
        g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) * (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (a • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (-b) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det *
          g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) *
          ((a • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (-b) •
            (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det * g O) ∂orthogonalHaar n := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun O => by
          dsimp only
          rw [hnorm O]
          ring
      _ = _ := integral_const_mul _ _
  have havg := affine_det_weighted_average hn a (-b) h hh hL1
  change (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (a • (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (-b) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det *
        g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      (-b) ^ n * (∫ O, g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) +
        a * (-b) ^ (n - 1) * (∫ O, U O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) at havg
  have hUc : Continuous U := by
    dsimp only [U]
    exact (continuous_apply j0).comp ((continuous_apply j0).comp continuous_subtype_val)
  have hU : Integrable (fun O => U O * g O) (orthogonalHaar n) :=
    hL1.bdd_mul hUc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
      (show ∀ᵐ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ ∂orthogonalHaar n, ‖U O‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) from
        Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun O => entry_norm_bound_of_unitary O.property j0 j0)
  have hlin : (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, (a * U O - b) * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      a * (∫ O, U O * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) - b * (∫ O, g O ∂orthogonalHaar n) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          a * (U O * g O) - b * g O ∂orthogonalHaar n := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun O => by ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [integral_sub (hU.const_mul a) (hL1.const_mul b), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rw [hstep, havg, hlin]
  have hn' : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
  have hp : (-b) ^ n = (-b) ^ (n - 1) * (-b) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hn', pow_succ]
  rw [hp]
  rw [neg_pow b (n - 1)]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

steps.title: Reuse the signed pointwise normalizer
steps.text: Put a=sqrt(kappa)+1 and b=sqrt(kappa)-1. The already compiled equation18 gives det(O)sqrt(det A_O)=2^(-n)det(aO-bI). Its positive square-root branch was proved internally in the earlier packet.
steps.lean: The public proof calls the existing singleBlockPrecision_signed_sqrt_det on the identical actual precision. No Gaussian density normalization is assumed. The earlier Lean proof uses a squared-norm kernel contradiction and continuity; the source quantitative path norm lower bound remains a separately visible source estimate.

steps.title: Expand the determinant by multilinearity
steps.text: Choose, independently in each row of aO+bI, either the O row or the identity row. Group choices by S. Extract row scalars and use the canonical principal-submatrix determinant identity. This yields an exact finite expansion, with no stochastic approximation.
steps.lean: det_affine_principalMinor uses detRowAlternating.map_add_univ/map_smul_univ and Matrix.det_piecewise_one_eq_submatrix_det. The previously retrieved polynomial coefficient theorem is not called; the actual dependency is row multilinearity plus the canonical submatrix identity.

steps.title: Pass only finite sums through the integral
steps.text: For each S, integrable_minor_weight supplies the real L1 obligation. Thus finite-sum linearity and constant extraction are legal for the actual law. Every term whose S contains a non-first coordinate vanishes by the preceding public cancellation theorem.
steps.lean: The private affine_det_weighted_average genuinely consumes principalMinor_weighted_integral_eq_zero, checks each integral_finsetSum premise and reduces the finite sum using Finset.sum_subset.

steps.title: Evaluate the two survivors
steps.text: If S has no non-first index, then S is empty or consists of the first coordinate. Their determinants are 1 and U. Hence the sum is (-b)^n E[h(U)]+a(-b)^(n-1)E[Uh(U)]. The bound |U|<=1 proves U h(U) is L1 from the source hypothesis.
steps.lean: Empty and singleton determinants use det_eq_one_of_card_eq_zero and det_eq_elem_of_card_eq_one. entry_norm_bound_of_unitary and Integrable.bdd_mul supply the actual weighted-coordinate integrability.

steps.title: Keep the parity and normalization exact
steps.text: Use n=(n-1)+1 and (-b)^(n-1)=(-1)^(n-1)b^(n-1), then combine the two finite expectations by integral linearity. The exact coefficient is the one in equation15.
steps.lean: The final proof uses integral_sub with actual L1 arguments and elementary ring identities. Concrete tests check the nonzero averages -1/8 for n3 and +1/16 for n4 at kappa4, so discarding the empty term or losing parity is detected.

reconstruction.text: For every natural number n >= 3 and every real kappa >= 4, let mu be normalized Haar probability measure on the full real orthogonal group O(n), equipped with its Borel sigma-algebra. Let h: R -> R be Borel measurable and assume integral_{O(n)} |h(O_{00})| dmu(O) < infinity. Define A_kappa(O) = ((kappa+1)/2) I_n - ((kappa-1)/4)(O+O^T), and let all square roots denote nonnegative real square roots. Then integral_{O(n)} det(O) sqrt(det(A_kappa(O))) h(O_{00}) dmu(O) = [(-1)^(n-1) (sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1) / 2^n] integral_{O(n)} [ (sqrt(kappa)+1) O_{00} - (sqrt(kappa)-1) ] h(O_{00}) dmu(O).
